resources.string: Hisab can read the messages your bank and mobile wallet send you, and add each transaction to your ledger as it arrives.

• Hisab reads the text messages (SMS) this phone receives.
• Only messages from banks and mobile wallets that are about money are sent to your Hisab account, over an encrypted connection. Messages from people and verification codes stay on this phone and are never sent.
• A message is used only to add its transaction, its fee and your balance. It is never shared with anyone else.
• Not your account? Choose Not now.
• Turn it off any time in Settings in Hisab, or here.
Also bring in messages from the last 30 days
New messages from your bank and wallet will be added as they arrive. Hisab lets you know what it added, and keeps anything unclear for you to check on Import SMS.
That link has expired. Start again from Settings in Hisab.
Couldn\'t reach Hisab. Check the connection and try again.
Hisab can\'t read your bank messages without permission to read SMS. You can still paste messages on the Import SMS page.

To allow it, open the phone\'s settings for Hisab and turn on SMS under Permissions. If Android says the setting is restricted, tap ⋮ at the top of that screen and choose Allow restricted settings first.
To turn it on, open Settings in Hisab and choose Set up on this phone.
This phone sends messages about money from your bank and wallet to Hisab as they arrive.
This phone is linked, but Hisab isn\'t allowed to read SMS, so nothing is sent. Allow it in the phone\'s settings to carry on.
Each transaction Hisab adds from a bank or wallet message.
